facts.text: I am planning a 4-day trip to Rome.

On my last trip to Paris, I packed a lot of clothes.
On my last 5-day trip to Paris, I wore 2 shirts the entire trip.
On my last 5-day trip to Paris, I wore 2 pairs of pants the entire trip.
On my last 5-day trip to Paris, I wore 1 dress the entire trip.
I am worried about not having enough clothes.
I tend to pack clothes that I haven't worn in months.
I want advice on how to be more ruthless about getting rid of old clothes and not packing them.
I started using packing cubes since my last trip to Paris.
I find that packing cubes keep my clothes organized and easy to find.
